rw_faq.answer: Yes, a dofollow link on a domain rated 57.

rw_faq.question: Do I need to link back to DevHunt?

rw_faq.question: What gets a listing rejected?
rw_faq.answer: Products with no live URL.

rw_source_lead: Free, no account, and the text link they ask you to paste has a typo in it.
rw_what_you_get: A dofollow listing in exchange for a text link on your site, after a hand review with no published window.
rw_you_need: Their text link on your site before you submit
An AI-related product with substantive content built for end users
No account is needed
rw_eligibility: You need their text link, an AI product with real content and an end-user focus. Anything cryptocurrency-related and thin sites are rejected.
rw_submit_steps: 1 Add their link. They give the exact anchor to paste and say the free submission only succeeds once it is up.
2 Fill the form: name, a short description, your URL, an email and the URL of the page carrying their link. No account at any point.
3 Wait. Every submission is reviewed by hand with no published window.
rw_submit_requirements: Their text link — an anchor, not an image badge
The URL of the page carrying their anchor
rw_rejection_reasons: Anything cryptocurrency-related, excluded by name, and thin sites without substantive content
rw_gotchas: The anchor they hand you has a typo, reading RightAI Tools Diresctory. Their checker may match that string, so paste it exactly rather than correcting it.
Cryptocurrency products are excluded by name in their criteria, which few directories state outright.
They say submitting does not guarantee publication and publish no review window at all.
No account is needed anywhere, so there is nothing to check a status against.

rw_source_lead: A two-field form that looks free until you press submit and a monthly subscription appears.
rw_what_you_get: A dofollow listing, but only behind a $29.9 monthly subscription revealed at the final click.
rw_you_need: A Google account, demanded by the submit click
A $29.9 monthly subscription
A website name and URL
rw_eligibility: You need a Google account, a recurring payment and an AI tool. Anything that is not an AI tool is rejected.
rw_submit_steps: 1 Open the submit page: two fields, website name and URL. Nothing on the page mentions a price.
2 Press Submit signed out. A Google login modal appears; signing in creates the account.
3 Press Submit signed in. A paywall modal replaces the action: Get plan for submit AI at $29.9 a month, with card and PayPal buttons.
4 Decide. There is no free lane behind the modal and no one-time price.
rw_rejection_reasons: Anything that is not an AI tool
rw_gotchas: The price is invisible until the last click: the form, fields and sign-in all complete before the $29.9 monthly modal appears.
It is a subscription, not a one-time listing fee, so a single product pays monthly for a listing it only needed once.
The directory is AI-only.
